page_title: MAL 0-1 RMA | Mallorca v Real Madrid 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
90+4' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Predrag Rajkovic.
90+2' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' It will be a substitution. Eder Militao (Real Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Lucas Vazquez walks off.
89' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
87' The attendance is 23244.
86' Javier Aguirre has decided to make a change. Cyle Larin (Mallorca) replaces Daniel Rodriguez.
86' Substitution. Luka Modric did his best and is replaced by Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid).
85' That's a clear yellow card. Andriy Lunin (Real Madrid) goes into the book.
83' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
81' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort.
80' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared.
78' That will be all from Pablo Maffeo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca).
76' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
74' The corner kick from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

74' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
73' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
69' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

68' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Predrag Rajkovic was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
66' The free kick picks out Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) in space, but his close-range header flies miles past the right post.
64' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Jude Bellingham and he is replaced by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
63' Substitution. Brahim Diaz is replaced by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
61' The ball rebounds to Luka Modric (Real Madrid) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.

61' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Predrag Rajkovic blocks the shot with his legs.
61' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
59' Substitution. Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) in, Manu Morlanes out.
59' Javier Aguirre decides to make a substitution. Samu Costa will be replaced by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
59' Substitution. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) has come on for Antonio Sanchez.
57' Surely that's handball by one of the Mallorca players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

55' Great solo effort by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) as he beats two defenders before unleashing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes a decent save.
52' Real Madrid restart play with a quick free kick.

48' 0 - 1 Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the top right corner. He makes it 0:1 with this magnificent strike.
47' A snap shot by Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Predrag Rajkovic produces a good save to thwart him.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Jose Sanchez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
43' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul after Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) hacks down one of his opponents.
38' Some great controlled play and passing from Mallorca. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
35' The resulting corner, taken by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca), comes to nothing.
33' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
31' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) rises above the defence and powers a header at the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with a superb save.
31' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) steps up to send the ball in.
30' 34:66 – the latest ball possession ratio.
27' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
23' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
19' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
16' What was Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
13' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
12' Real Madrid have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
9' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
7' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
7' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
5' Samu Costa (Mallorca) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
